Readme

HarmonyOS Mobile Design System

A design system for building HarmonyOS mobile apps in the native visual language: a 360×792 canvas, floating glass title bars and pill tab bars, the three MaterialLevels, MaterialType light edges, immersive light feedback, and the platform's own HMSymbol icon font.

It exists to make one thing hard to get wrong: the geometry and the token layer. The reference's mandatory values (the 8px titlebar gap, 100 = 16 + 56 + 28, the locked pill widths) are encoded once and then measured, not restated in prose.

Design-time only. _ds_bundle.js is React/DOM code. It does not generate ArkTS and cannot be shipped in an app.

What crosses into a real project is the token layer, packaged as a HAR so that N apps share one copy instead of N copies:

node tools/build-token-har.mjs     # -> ../../harmonyos-tokens  (all generated)

An app then writes one line — "@yostar/harmony-tokens": "file:../../harmonyos-tokens" — and imports { Palette, Metrics }. See guidelines/multi-app-architecture.md.

Sources

Everything here is derived from the in-repo HarmonyOS reference library at ~/.agents/skills/hmos-design-visual-mobile/ (read-only; never modified):

  • references/0.governance/ — HarmonyOS Design.md, component.json (13 components), icon_role.md, emoji_role.md, and the official hmsymbol-map.json (v2.1, 404 icons)
  • references/1.layout/ — layout-card.md, layout-grid.md, layout-list.md
  • references/2.theme/ — harmony-tokens.css, mobile-scale.css, theme.md (which documents colours as ARGB)
  • references/3.component/ — 13 component specs
  • references/4.template/ — 13 component HTML templates, translated byte-for-byte
  • references/assets/ — HMSymbolVF_1.ttf, the eight status bar PNGs

The component CSS is not retyped: tools/import-template-css.mjs translates the templates (.harmony- → .hm-) and strips their @import/@font-face, leaving every value identical. What the bridge changes is listed, with reasons, in components/theme-bridge.css.

CONTENT FUNDAMENTALS

The reference library is Chinese and its copy style is consistent, so new screens should match it rather than invent a voice.

  • Language: Simplified Chinese for UI copy. Numbers and units stay Latin (148.3 MB, 12 张, 08:08), separated from Chinese by a space.
  • Tone: plain, operational, no exclamation marks, no marketing voice. A settings row says what it does: 同时下载数量 / 并发槽位，队列共用.
  • Sub-labels: a second line is lowercase-normal and factual — a unit, a count, a time (1.8 MB · 今天 14:26), never a second sentence of prose.
  • Titles: short nouns, no trailing punctuation. 首页, 发现, 设置, 文件.
  • Verdicts: one word, no colour-only meaning — 已完成 / 失败（with the tinted icon as reinforcement, not as the only signal）.
  • System capabilities: read-only demos say so. 以上为系统能力，应用只响应系统状态，不自行开关。
  • Buttons: verb-first and short. 新建下载任务, 恢复默认, 完成. A destructive action is the word itself — 删除 — never 确定 on a destructive warning dialog.
  • Empty/error copy: state the cause, not an apology. 服务器返回的不是图片.

VISUAL FOUNDATIONS

  • Canvas: 360×792, or 360×780 for the card layout. Content width 328 (360 − 16×2). Page padding 16 horizontally, 36 top, 28 bottom.
  • Colour: the brand is a fixed blue (#0A59F7) and does not change with the theme. Everything else is semantic: confirm (green), alert (secondary warning), warning (primary warning). Text has four levels plus an emphasized level.
  • Theme: light and dark, via data-theme on the canvas. Both sets are generated — 132 colours each. Never hard-code a colour in a page: a literal cannot flip.
  • Type: 13 steps. Display sizes are weight 300, titles 700, body 400, subtitles 500, captions 500. That pairing is deliberate — do not mix them. Font stack is HarmonyOS Sans (a system font, so there is no binary to embed).
  • Glass and material: every glass surface is *fill (with alpha) × backdrop blur × shadow stack*. Three MaterialLevels scale the thickness (EXQUISITE 1.5, GENTLE 1.0 the default, SMOOTH 0.4) and the fill alpha, so the levels are really different and not decoration. MaterialType: IMMERSIVE adds the light edge, and the edge is dropped entirely on the SMOOTH tier.
  • The light effect (沉浸光感): a radial glow that bleeds from the touch point, on focal components only — title bar, tab bar, dialogs, Slider/Toggle/Select, primary buttons. The reference's rule: 「满屏都是光感，就等于没有光感」. Mark an element with data-hm-light; SizeFrame runs one delegated listener for the frame.
  • Interaction: overlays are token-based (hover 4.7%, pressed 9.8%). Press feedback also shrinks a focal component slightly (0.955). Focus rings are 2px and never removed.
  • Elevation: expressed with glass and shadow, not with borders. Cards sit on the page by surface contrast (comp_background_primary over background_secondary).
  • Radii: 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 32 / 36 from corner-radius-level*. Pills are fully rounded, never a fixed small radius.
  • Floating layers: the title bar and bottom bar float; content scrolls under the title bar's fade and above the pill's 16px clearance. They are never flex siblings that take layout height. Hand them to SizeFrame's slots.
  • No imagery style is imposed. Product imagery is the app's own; the system ships no photographic treatment, no grain, no illustration style.

ICONOGRAPHY

  • HMSymbol only. The reference forbids hand-drawn inline SVG for any glyph the official dictionary already contains. assets/HMSymbolVF_1.ttf (1.7 MB) is the font; assets/hmsymbol-map.json is the full official name → codepoint dictionary.
  • Line variants only. When a semantic name has both an outline and a filled form, use the outline. Never mix *_fill into a line set.
  • 40 curated names are generated into components/controls/IconMap.jsx by tools/gen-icon-map.mjs, which fails the build on an unknown name and suggests near matches. A typo cannot reach a screen.
  • Render with <Icon name="chevron_right" size={24} />. Sizes are 16 / 20 / 24.
  • Two recorded dictionary gaps (carried honestly rather than papered over):
    • a line variant of the notification bell does not exist — only bell_fill, bell_slash, bell_slash_fill;
    • the real names for close and settings are xmark and gearshape; close and gear do not resolve.
  • The status bar glyphs are PNGs, not from the font (assets/statusbar-*.png, light and dark sets) — the reference ships them that way and forbids redrawing them.
  • On the ArkTS side use SymbolGlyph($r('sys.symbol.<name>')) — see the mapping doc.

Intentional additions

Five things exist here that the reference's component list of 13 does not contain. Each is either required by the reference's own rules or explicitly sanctioned by them.

AdditionWhy it is necessary
IconThe reference mandates HMSymbol for icons but provides no way to render one; a glyph needs a wrapper. The reference explicitly allows this kind of addition ("Icon wrapper for a glyph set"). Uses the font, never SVG.
SizeFrame slot placement (titlebar / bottomBar)The reference leaves layer placement to each page, which is how the mandatory 8px gap and the 100px container get broken. Placement moved into the frame.
SizeFrame light-effect delegateOne pointer listener per frame instead of a handler on every component. Keeps data-hm-light declarative and honours the focal-components-only rule.
.hm-spec* specimen chromeCard chrome for the guidelines pages. Ships with the system so a card renders identically from an imported copy; no component depends on it.
--harmony-icon-size-16/20/24The reference encoded icon sizes only as .hm-16/20/24 classes, so the token layer had no icon size and an ArkTS app had no resource to read.

Recorded gaps

Stated plainly, because a silently narrowed rule is worse than a known gap.

  1. Device variants are identification-only. SizeFrame accepts phone-landscape / foldable / tablet-* and emits them as attributes, but the reference defines a canvas size for phone-portrait only. Pass explicit width / height for other form factors.
  2. The bell has no line variant (see Iconography).
  3. HMSymbolVF_1.ttf is 1.7 MB and is copied into every consuming project. Subsetting is a possible follow-up.
  4. 2.4 MB of colour-emoji fonts were deliberately omitted. The reference ships HMOSColorEmojiCompat.ttf and HMOSColorEmojiFlags.ttf; emoji rendering falls back to the host font.
  5. --harmony-list-dot-color: #46B1E3 is kept as a spec literal rather than remapped to a semantic token — it is the one raw colour left in tokens/, and it is there because the reference gives that exact value for the list dot.
  6. The verifier does not launch a browser. R1–R12 are static; the geometry is verified by guidelines/geometry-anchors.html, which measures itself and prints ✓/✗ per anchor. Run both.
  7. Nothing checks that an ArkTS screen matches the HTML design. Token values are guaranteed identical; layout is not, because the engines differ.

styles.css              the only entry point — a list of @import lines, nothing else
fonts.css               @font-face for HMSymbol (HarmonyOS Sans is a system font)
base.css                host/frame, page canvas, showcase slots, scoped reset, light effect

tokens/                 GENERATED (except geometry + material, which are hand-written)
  colors.css            132 light + 132 dark
  typography.css        60
  spacing.css           50
  geometry.css          27   every value tagged SPEC or DERIVED
  material.css          20   primitives only — derived values compose in the bridge

components/
  shell/                SizeFrame · StatusBar · Titlebar · BottomTab · AIBottomBar · Toolbar
  controls/             Icon · Button · Switch · FloatingSearch · FloatingChipsTab · IconMap(generated)
  containers/           CardView · List · Divider
  theme-bridge.css      the one hand-audited override layer (each override states why)

guidelines/             16 foundation cards + arkui-mapping.md
ui_kits/
  card/                 mobile-card · 360×780
  grid/                 mobile-grid · 360×792
  list/                 mobile-list · 360×792
  settings/             mobile-list, control rows

tools/
  sync-tokens.mjs           tokens ← the reference library          (--check)
  import-template-css.mjs   templates → component CSS               (--check)
  gen-icon-map.mjs          icon names → codepoints                 (--check)
  annotate-tokens.mjs       stamps @kind on the hand-written files  (--check)
  verify-harmony.mjs        12 conformance rules
  emit-ohos-resources.mjs   tokens → ArkTS resource JSON (one app's resources/)
  build-token-har.mjs       tokens → a shareable HAR            (--check)
  check-app-drift.mjs       does an app still match the tokens?
  lib/ohos-tokens.mjs       shared token → resource conversion (one app's resources/)
  build-token-har.mjs       tokens → a shareable HAR            (--check)
  check-app-drift.mjs       does an app still match the tokens?

guidelines/arkui-mapping.md            tokens → ArkTS, and the honest gaps
guidelines/multi-app-architecture.md   how N apps share one system (skill vs HAR)

ohos-resources/         a generated sample of what emit-ohos-resources.mjs writes:
  entry/src/main/resources/
    base/element/color.json    85 colours, #AARRGGBB
    dark/element/color.json    85 dark overrides
    base/element/float.json    91 dimensions (calc() already evaluated)

compliance.md           the rules and the 13 traps
preview.html            every card in one self-contained file

Siblings outside this tree — a .jsx inside it would be bundled as a component, which is why neither of these lives here:

  • harmonyos-tokens/ — the generated HAR that apps depend on
  • harmonyos-mobile-verify-fixture/ — the fixture verify-harmony.mjs must fail on
  • apps/harmony-starter/ — a compiling app that consumes the HAR

Portable

Copy the whole harmonyos-mobile/ folder into another repo's designs/ and it works: SKILL.md makes it downloadable as an Agent Skill, its first heading and paragraph are what a consumer's picker shows, and no path escapes the folder.
